sequence.cn: 喝完酒脸发烫，头发晕，这就叫上头。
sequence.py: Hē wán jiǔ liǎn fā tàng, tóu fā yūn, zhè jiù jiào shàngtóu.
sequence.en: Your face burns and your head spins after drinking — that's 上头.

sequence.cn: 现在不用喝酒，一首歌也能让你上头。
sequence.py: Xiànzài bú yòng hē jiǔ, yì shǒu gē yě néng ràng nǐ shàngtóu.
sequence.en: These days you don't need a drink — one song can do it to you.

sequence.cn: 上头，就是喜欢到停不下来，什么道理都听不进去。
sequence.py: Shàngtóu, jiù shì xǐhuan dào tíng bu xiàlái, shénme dàolǐ dōu tīng bu jìnqù.
sequence.en: 上头 is liking something so much you can't stop — and no reasoning gets through.

sequence.cn: 上个月我给我妈推荐了一部剧，她说看两集就睡。
sequence.py: Shàng ge yuè wǒ gěi wǒ mā tuījiàn le yí bù jù, tā shuō kàn liǎng jí jiù shuì.
sequence.en: Last month I recommended a drama to my mom; she said two episodes and she'd be asleep.

sequence.cn: 那天半夜我起来喝水，她房间的灯还亮着。
sequence.py: Nà tiān bànyè wǒ qǐlái hē shuǐ, tā fángjiān de dēng hái liàngzhe.
sequence.en: I got up for water in the middle of the night — the light in her room was still on.

sequence.cn: 第二天早上她眼睛通红，开口就问：第二季呢？
sequence.py: Dì-èr tiān zǎoshang tā yǎnjing tōnghóng, kāikǒu jiù wèn: dì-èr jì ne?
sequence.en: Next morning, eyes bright red, the first thing out of her mouth was: where's season two?

sequence.cn: 两天四十集，她一集都没跳过，饭端到房间里吃。
sequence.py: Liǎng tiān sìshí jí, tā yì jí dōu méi tiào guo, fàn duān dào fángjiān lǐ chī.
sequence.en: Forty episodes in two days, not one skipped, meals carried into her room.

sequence.cn: 连每天的广场舞，她都停了三天。
sequence.py: Lián měi tiān de guǎngchǎngwǔ, tā dōu tíng le sān tiān.
sequence.en: She even gave up her nightly square dancing for three days.

sequence.cn: 她说再也不看了，可第二季一出，她还是第一个点开。
sequence.py: Tā shuō zài yě bú kàn le, kě dì-èr jì yì chū, tā háishi dì-yī ge diǎn kāi.
sequence.en: She swore she was done — then season two dropped and she was the first to hit play.
